svg.title: New user onboarding — overview
svg.desc: Read top to bottom. Lifelines distinguish the user, setup assistant, ACED, stage agents, and existing tools and infrastructure including independent monitoring and stopping. This is the integration qualification procedure; it does not certify a live cycle.
svg.text: PREVIEW · qualification required · arrows are interactions, not elapsed time
Configure existing identity, permissions and supervision
Exercise the actual runner in an isolated
Verify independent stopping and interruption recovery
Fix authorized setup issues and repeat failed checks
Before each task: persist inputs and budget, obtain host authorization
Verify zero, separation and prior execution
Reconcile original operations and verify stopping
Setup assistant can exit; independent protection remains available
Development preview · typed Python setup · live qualification required
